title: New workflow authoring through the installed workspace
summary: A fresh empty verification workflow, preserved editor authoring and no execution; stop at the first confusing or failing state.

manualSteps.label: Workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated workspace and click Workflows.

manualSteps.label: New workflow
manualSteps.instruction: Choose Workflow files, then New workflow.

manualSteps.label: Author
manualSteps.instruction: Read the creation instructions, provide a name and create the verification workflow.

steps.label: Normal workspace editor entry
steps.summary: Existing editor and workflow file menu are visible.
steps.expected: Existing editor opens within the workspace.
steps.actual: Existing editor and workflow file menu are visible.

steps.label: Accurate new-workflow instructions
steps.summary: The installed dialog describes blank-workflow creation and readiness.
steps.actual: The installed dialog describes blank-workflow creation and readiness.

steps.label: Fresh blank source
steps.summary: The scratch workflow source contains its name and no task/input/connection/item declarations.
steps.action: Create Editor verification 083 010 and open Source.
steps.expected: A new, separate workflow has no prefilled engineering steps.
steps.actual: The scratch workflow source contains its name and no task/input/connection/item declarations.

steps.label: Direct input configuration
steps.summary: Text input and its direct inspector field are visible and configured.
steps.action: Create Text input and enter engineering text.
steps.expected: Input inspector edits the same workflow.
steps.actual: Text input and its direct inspector field are visible and configured.

steps.label: Undo and redo
steps.summary: Undo removes the entered value and Redo restores it.
steps.action: Undo the text edit, then Redo.
steps.expected: Both controls restore accepted editing state.
steps.actual: Undo removes the entered value and Redo restores it.

steps.label: Individual AI steps
steps.summary: Two separate AI prompt steps appear; no model work is started.
steps.expected: Both new steps appear in the established canvas.
steps.actual: Two separate AI prompt steps appear; no model work is started.

steps.label: Typed connection in source
steps.summary: The keyboard-created connection appears in canonical source.
steps.action: Connect the first Response to the second Prompt using Enter.
steps.expected: A type-compatible connection appears in the same source.
steps.actual: The keyboard-created connection appears in canonical source.

steps.label: Actual pointer socket connection
steps.summary: Dragging Design text to the first Prompt adds the second connection to canonical source.
steps.purpose: Preserve actual mouse authoring, not only keyboard connection.
steps.action: Drag the Text input Design text output to the first AI prompt Prompt input; inspect Source.
steps.expected: The typed pointer connection changes the accepted graph and appears in source.
steps.actual: The semantic digest changes and source records two connections, including the exact input/output keys.

steps.label: Pan changes only the viewport
steps.summary: Dragging empty canvas pans without changing the workflow or node layout.
steps.purpose: Preserve navigation independently from accepted process edits.
steps.action: Drag empty canvas 90 pixels right and 45 pixels up.
steps.expected: The viewport moves; source and node layout remain unchanged.
steps.actual: The viewport transform changes while both semantic and layout digests stay identical.

steps.label: Editor accessibility scan
steps.summary: Automated axe WCAG 2/2.1 A/AA scan reports no violations; manual/assistive-technology acceptance remains separate.
steps.action: Inspect active editor WCAG A/AA semantics and contrast.
steps.expected: No detected A/AA accessibility violations in the active editor.
steps.actual: Automated axe WCAG 2/2.1 A/AA scan reports no violations; manual/assistive-technology acceptance remains separate.

steps.label: Saved source reopens
steps.summary: Reload restores the saved input, two AI steps and connection exactly.
steps.expected: The exact saved workflow reopens without execution.
steps.actual: Reload restores the saved input, two AI steps and connection exactly.

steps.label: Invalid draft stays isolated
steps.summary: Managed-field diagnostic is visible, accepted revision is unchanged and Run is disabled.
steps.action: Enter a source draft containing managed revision: 99 and Apply.
steps.expected: Invalid source leaves accepted revision intact and blocks Run.
steps.actual: Managed-field diagnostic is visible, accepted revision is unchanged and Run is disabled.
